hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — 5, 4, 10. You bet. Your opponent raised you back.

wrongReasons: J 7 has similar strength, but look at when the aggression shifted — the turn card connects with the correct hand in a way it doesn't connect with J 7.
6 5 makes a full house here — a hand that strong would have raised earlier and pushed harder for maximum value. The measured sizing in this hand points to something weaker.
7 6 has similar strength, but look at when the aggression shifted — the turn card connects with the correct hand in a way it doesn't connect with 7 6.
hand.explanation:
Answer: A Q

Your opponent flopped three of a kind and raised the flop immediately to build the pot. Sets are too strong to slow-play — they pushed their advantage on every street.
